title: GEMglRasterPos4s
description: specify the raster position for pixel operations

messages.description: x coordinate of the raster position
y coordinate of the raster position
z coordinate of the raster position
w coordinate of the raster position

arguments.description: x coordinate of the raster position
y coordinate of the raster position
z coordinate of the raster position
w coordinate of the raster position

body: [GEMglRasterPos4s] calls glRasterPos4s() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glRasterPos in the OpenGL reference.
